address: High Street, Bray, SL6 2AB, United Kingdom
bio: Set in the Thameside village of Bray, this sweet, quintessentially English inn is best known as Heston Blumenthal’s informal dining option – but that doesn’t make it any less enticing. Concise menus offer time-honoured British dishes presented in a clean, modern style, with punchy flavours and the occasional playful element. The combinations work beautifully and dishes are executed with the utmost precision. Service is relaxed and friendly, and the atmosphere buzzes with the hum of contented diners....
